name: close_tab
description: Close a browser tab. Defaults to the currently active tab when tab_id is omitted. Use when a popup, modal-style overlay, or a side-tab is no longer relevant to the task.

inputs.name: tab_id
inputs.description: Optional tab id; defaults to the currently active tab. Pass an explicit tab_id when closing a background tab (e.g. dismissing a popup that opened without focus stealing).
